queryLines: SELECT * EXCEPT (`as_of_date`, `event_date`, `top_reasons`), CAST(`as_of_date` AS DATE) AS `as_of_date`, CAST(`event_date` AS DATE) AS `event_date`, concat_ws(' · ', `top_reasons`) AS `top_reasons`

FROM (WITH trip_profile AS (SELECT CAST(pickup_zip AS STRING) AS entity_id, HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_hour, MAX(DATE(tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS event_date FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CAST(pickup_zip AS STRING), HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime)) SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, array_join(o.top_reasons, ' · ') AS top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.value_at_stake, o.as_of_date, o.confidence_level, o.data_quality_flag, o.ai_cat_driver AS allocation_driver, o.ai_cat_time_band AS time_band, o.method, o.segment_or_item, TRY_CAST(o.segment_or_item AS TIMESTAMP) AS planning_hour, o.entity_id AS zone, p.event_date FROM main.inspire.n03_u02_out AS o LEFT JOIN trip_profile AS p ON p.entity_id = o.entity_id AND p.pickup_hour = HOUR(TRY_CAST(o.segment_or_item AS TIMESTAMP)) WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete') AS d

datasets.name: run_health
queryLines:
SELECT run_id, as_of_date, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MAX(model_version) AS model_version,
100.0 * COUNT_IF(data_quality_flag <> 'ok') / COUNT(*) AS flagged_share
FROM `main`.`_inspire`.`n03_u02_out`
WHERE change_source = 'run'
GROUP BY run_id, as_of_date
ORDER BY as_of_date DESC

datasets.name: run_status
queryLines: SELECT CASE WHEN l.`seen` IS NULL THEN 'Not run yet' WHEN l.`unreliable` IS NOT NULL THEN 'Not reliable yet' WHEN COALESCE(l.`act`, 0) = 0 THEN 'Nothing to act on yet' ELSE concat(format_number(COALESCE(l.`act`, 0), 0), ' to act on now') END AS `headline`, CASE WHEN l.`seen` IS NULL THEN 'No run of this use case has written its results yet.' WHEN l.`unreliable` IS NOT NULL THEN concat('Not reliable yet: ', l.`unreliable`) WHEN COALESCE(l.`act`, 0) = 0 THEN concat('Nothing to act on yet, because ', CASE WHEN substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.`nothing`), ''), 'no record reached Act now in the last run.'), 1, 1) BETWEEN 'A' AND 'Z' AND substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.`nothing`), ''), 'no record reached Act now in the last run.'), 2, 1) BETWEEN 'a' AND 'z' THEN concat(lower(substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.`nothing`), ''), 'no record reached Act now in the last run.'), 1, 1)), substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.`nothing`), ''), 'no record reached Act now in the last run.'), 2)) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.`nothing`), ''), 'no record reached Act now in the last run.') END) ELSE concat(format_number(COALESCE(l.`act`, 0), 0), CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.`act`, 0) = 1 THEN ' record to act on now' ELSE ' records to act on now' END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.`over`, 0) > 0 THEN concat('; ', format_number(COALESCE(l.`over`, 0), 0), CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.`over`, 0) = 1 THEN ' more record would' ELSE ' more records would' END, ' qualify for Act now, but the team capacity of ', format_number(l.`cap`, 0), ' a run holds ', CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.`over`, 0) = 1 THEN 'it' ELSE 'them' END, ' in Review') ELSE '' END, '.') END AS `sentence` FROM (SELECT 1 AS `one`) AS z LEFT JOIN (SELECT 1 AS `seen`, CAST(`not_reliable` AS STRING) AS `unreliable`, CAST(`nothing_to_act` AS STRING) AS `nothing`, CAST(`act_now_records` AS BIGINT) AS `act`, CAST(`over_capacity_records` AS BIGINT) AS `over`, CAST(`act_now_capacity` AS BIGINT) AS `cap` FROM `main`.`_inspire`.`n03_u02_out_summary` WHERE `use_case_id` = 'N03-U02' ORDER BY `updated_at` DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS l ON TRUE

datasets.name: returns
datasets.sql: WITH runs AS (SELECT DISTINCT as_of_date FROM main.inspire.n03_u09_out WHERE is_current AND change_source <> 'delete'), lines AS (SELECT 'Store' AS channel, date_from_unix_date(sr_returned_date_sk - 2440588) AS event_date, sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sr_item_sk AS item_sk, GREATEST(COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0D), 0D) AS loss_amount FROM samples.tpcds_sf1.store_returns UNION ALL SELECT 'Catalog' AS channel, date_from_unix_date(cr_returned_date_sk - 2440588) AS event_date, cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, cr_item_sk AS item_sk, GREATEST(COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0D), 0D) AS loss_amount FROM samples.tpcds_sf1.catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT 'Web' AS channel, date_from_unix_date(wr_returned_date_sk - 2440588) AS event_date, wr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, wr_item_sk AS item_sk, GREATEST(COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0D), 0D) AS loss_amount FROM samples.tpcds_sf1.web_returns) SELECT runs.as_of_date, lines.event_date, lines.channel, reason.r_reason_desc AS return_reason, item.i_category AS category, item.i_class AS item_class, lines.loss_amount, 1 AS return_line FROM lines JOIN samples.tpcds_sf1.reason AS reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = lines.reason_sk JOIN samples.tpcds_sf1.item AS item ON item.i_item_sk = lines.item_sk CROSS JOIN runs

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: WITH line_keys AS (SELECT 'Store' AS channel, date_from_unix_date(sr_returned_date_sk - 2440588) AS event_date, sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sr_item_sk AS item_sk FROM samples.tpcds_sf1.store_returns UNION ALL SELECT 'Catalog' AS channel, date_from_unix_date(cr_returned_date_sk - 2440588) AS event_date, cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, cr_item_sk AS item_sk FROM samples.tpcds_sf1.catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT 'Web' AS channel, date_from_unix_date(wr_returned_date_sk - 2440588) AS event_date, wr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, wr_item_sk AS item_sk FROM samples.tpcds_sf1.web_returns), latest_event AS (SELECT line_keys.channel, reason.r_reason_desc AS return_reason, item.i_category AS category, MAX(line_keys.event_date) AS event_date FROM line_keys JOIN samples.tpcds_sf1.reason AS reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = line_keys.reason_sk JOIN samples.tpcds_sf1.item AS item ON item.i_item_sk = line_keys.item_sk GROUP BY line_keys.channel, reason.r_reason_desc, item.i_category), current_rows AS (SELECT o.*, split_part(o.entity_id, '|', 1) AS channel, split_part(o.entity_id, '|', 2) AS return_reason, split_part(o.entity_id, '|', 3) AS category FROM main.inspire.n03_u09_out AS o WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete') SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.rank, array_join(o.top_reasons, ' · ') AS top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.value_at_stake, o.as_of_date, e.event_date, o.channel, o.return_reason, o.category, o.confidence_level, o.data_quality_flag, CASE WHEN o.priority_tier = 'Act now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS act_now_row, CASE WHEN o.data_quality_flag <> 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS issue_row FROM current_rows AS o LEFT JOIN latest_event AS e ON e.channel = o.channel AND e.return_reason = o.return_reason AND e.category = o.category
